subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Per-vehicle physics state and lifecycle: suspension/tire force computation, per-frame integration step configuration, wheel-space and rigid-body transforms, respawn/reset and cleanup, vehicle audio config loading, and collision spark/damage feedback.

summary: Reconstructs the vehicle physics subsystem from 15 validated functions sharing a single 'this'-base object (VehiclePhysicsObject). The object carries default-initialized suspension/contact constants (0x0..0x144), a 74-float-stride wheel-state block at 0xD4, respawn/reset/collision-zone state (0x828..0x990), audio playback sub-slots, per-frame integration fields (0x3498..0x34AC), a 3x3 orientation matrix plus world position (0x34B0..0x34DC), a camera/rendering snapshot block, rigid-body point transforms, and collision damage-feedback thresholds. Behavior is split between respawn/reset drivers (0x4E0800, 0x4E09E0), per-frame step configuration (0x4E45B0), force/torque solving over four wheels (0x4E5470), lock-guarded physics-node propagation (0x4E4910), per-frame setup snapshots (0x4E49B0), vehicle audio config loading (0x4E3360), and collision spark/damage feedback (0x4EC1A0), supported by shared helper services (tire-brush solver, HDV parser, audio-stream record parser, transform math, lifecycle reset, collision feedback, memory).

function_roles.role: Default-initializer for the unnamed vehicle physics-state object: writes 82 DWORD literals into this[0..81] (offsets 0x0..0x144) - -1/0 sentinel slots at 0x130..0x144 followed by contact/geometry, suspension/strut and scalar/vector default constant blocks. No reads, globals, branches or calls. Invoked once by TireBrandFileParser.

Temperature-scaled suspension force helper: force = (this+0x118 + 273.16) * a2 * 0.002778858444950814 * (this+0x38) + (this+0x40). Reads the Kelvin-conversion term, an input factor and two field scalars; returns the computed force.

Vehicle respawn / race-restart state reset: clears the respawn marker byte, runs a conditional aux reset (sub_5506A0) on a prior-collision flag, computes a random respawn delay from the rotating noise table, re-initializes substructures (MultiSystemStructInitializer, optional StateArrayReset), writes a progress-bar event when the base object is not in an active race, resets audio/sound state and scale propagation, zeroes collision force/torque accumulators, writes sentinel IDs, computes a speed scale, dispatches per-contact-zone resets and clears pending-cleanup entries.

Full vehicle state reset/destructor path: conditional multi-system re-init, 3D sound-source destruction and collision-status copy from the geometry object; zeroes timer/counter/wheel/sensor/audio field runs; runs embedded-array init/destructor loops (4x stride-296, 17-element and 68-byte loops, 11x stride-748 dual-array destructors); frees and nulls the pointer slot at this+0x2BD4 and returns the freed pointer.

3x3 rotation-plus-translation transform: copies rotation angles to this+0x14..0x1C, a 0x24-byte 3x3 rotation matrix to this+0x20..0x40, and the translation vector to this+0x54..0x5C; computes matrix * (this+0x48..0x50) + translation into this+0x8/0xC/0x10 and returns a pointer to that result.

Per-wheel suspension parameter update (wheel index a2, 74-float per-wheel stride): computes ride-height offset v5 = a3 - this+0x4C, stores it into two per-wheel slots, computes the new damper angle a5 + stored angle, stores the steering angle; only on an actual damper-angle change saves the angle and rebuilds the 3x3 rotation matrix via F_33RotationMatrixFromEulerAngles; copies a 0x24-byte wheel-state block and returns the Y-axis Euler extraction of the steering orientation.

Vehicle audio/sound configuration loader: resolves the vehicle name from the vehicle-database array, parses its .hdv file, opens the audio stream, reads restriction-sphere and force-field-sphere records (counting and allocating per-record slots), initializes per-vehicle audio playback sub-slots (base slot, two conditional slots, 8 stride-68 group entries) via sub_4DE610, then frees scratch allocations and returns the leftover pointer.
Cleanup/destructor sequence: calls sub_4E4790(this), runs DualArrayDestructorLoopFree on the dual-array storage at this+441, then returns the result of a thunk dispatch on (this+2).

Per-frame vehicle physics configuration and one integration step: calls sub_4E4790, gates on a mode flag at this+0x32BC (0 = one-time TireModelInit into dbl_7C7428; 1..3 = step; else early return), parses the vehicle HDV file twice, clamps the integration sub-step count at this+0x3498 to [1,64], derives four step-size fields, runs SuspensionAndWheelPhysics and TireBrushModelForceSolver, frees temp allocations and returns the leftover pointer.

Thin lock-guarded wrapper around the tire-brush solver and physics-node propagation: acquires TireBrushModelForceSolver(1), runs PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff over the node set dword_5EA2C0, releases TireBrushModelForceSolver(0), returns the solver result.

Per-frame setup/rendering snapshot copy from global physics state: steering-geometry result via TransformApply3D, 3x3 orientation matrix copy, gimbal-lock-guarded pitch/roll atan2, world position copy, camera-projection rows, a 4-entry per-corner camera-data copy, mode-selected suspension-ride-height average, camera scale/offset calculations; returns the physics-global base pointer.

Per-frame suspension force/torque computation over all 4 wheels (stride 62 floats): transforms per-wheel vectors through the wheel-space rotation matrix plus world offset, computes steer cross products and cos/sin of the steering-angle product, runs TireContactForceComputation and WheelSpringDamperForceAndSteering per wheel, applies body-roll torque redistribution gated on a matrix element > 0.7, damps per-wheel values and accumulates forces/torques back into per-wheel slots.

Rigid-body point transform: transforms the local offset vector at this+0x3B54..0x3B5C by the 3x3 rotation matrix at this+0x34B0, adds the body world position at this+0x34D4..0x34DC, stores the world-space result at this+0x3B60/0x3B64/0x3B68.

Per-frame collision visual/damage feedback: gated by vehicle identity vs dword_7C54E8 and restricted-mode/race-phase guards, scales the impact impulse, fires spark/damage events into a ring buffer (ProgressBarEventEncode + StateTransition), runs two body-zone repair-service blocks, an 8-zone body loop and a 4-zone wheel loop with RepairServiceStateDispatcher/ShortComputation_1330, applies steering-geometry deformation and tire-scrub reset on severe impacts.

Coordinate transform with offset: builds a 3x3 rotation matrix from Euler input a3, computes the ride-height delta 3-vector, rotates it by the matrix, adds the position offset at this+0x34D4..0x34DC, and writes into a4 the difference between (a2 + position offset) and the transformed vector.

classes.name: VehiclePhysicsObject
classes.responsibility: Per-vehicle physics and state object: default-initialized contact/geometry and suspension/strut constant block (0x0..0x144), 74-float-stride wheel-state block based at 0xD4, collision/respawn/reset state (0x828..0x990), audio playback sub-slots (0x5E4..0x6AD, count at 0xBA8), body/wheel collision-zone gating (0xCC8..0xD90), pointer slot pair at 0x2BD0, per-frame integration fields (0x3498..0x34AC), 3x3 orientation matrix + world position (0x34B0..0x34DC), camera/rendering snapshot block (0x3510..0x39F0), rigid-body contact point transform (0x3B54..0x3B68), and collision damage-feedback thresholds (0x3D48..0x3EB8).

state_machines.name: VehiclePhysicsMode
transitions: mode flag this+0x32BC == 0 -> one-time TireModelInit into dbl_7C7428 then step path
mode flag this+0x32BC in [1,3] -> step path (HDV parse, substep clamp, force solving)
mode flag this+0x32BC outside [0,3] -> early return without stepping

state_machines.name: CollisionFeedbackGating
transitions: this[0] == dword_7C54E8 and gate bytes clear -> primary (player) feedback path
identity differs and restricted-mode flag != 1 -> main body runs
identity differs and race phase not in {1,3} -> main body runs
identity differs, restricted-mode flag == 1 and race phase in {1,3} -> suppressed

interfaces.name: TireBrushModelService
interfaces.purpose: Tire-brush force model: per-frame force/torque solving with a lock protocol (1 = acquire, 0 = release) and per-wheel contact/spring-damper helpers.

interfaces.name: VehicleHdvParser
interfaces.purpose: Vehicle .hdv file parsing and session/tire-model scratch initializers shared by config and audio loading.

interfaces.name: AudioStreamRecordParser
interfaces.purpose: Conditional audio-stream record iteration: open/dispatch/close primitives and restriction/force-field sphere token readers used by vehicle audio config.

interfaces.name: TransformMathService
interfaces.purpose: Rotation/transform math helpers: 3x3 matrix construction, Euler extraction, ride-height delta and coordinate transforms.

interfaces.name: CollisionDamageFeedbackService
interfaces.purpose: Collision damage/spark event services: ring-buffer event encoding, state transitions, per-zone repair-service dispatch and steering-geometry deformation.

interfaces.name: LifecycleResetService
interfaces.purpose: Vehicle substructure lifecycle: multi-system state init/reset, array and dual-array destructors, timer clamp, scale propagation and audio sub-slot initialization.

interfaces.name: CollisionSystemService
interfaces.purpose: Global collision system hooks: conditional resets, contact-zone dispatch, 3D sound-source destruction and string-buffer reallocation.

interfaces.name: MemoryService
interfaces.purpose: Heap scratch allocation/free primitives and stack-buffer cleanup helpers used across physics and audio config paths.

interfaces.name: PhysicsNodePropagationService
interfaces.purpose: Physics-node propagation with distance falloff over the global node set.

interfaces.name: FlagGatedStubService
interfaces.purpose: Compiler/feature-flag stub gates invoked around the tire-contact pass.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehiclePhysicsObjectLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement executable must preserve the vehicle physics-state layout: wheel-state block with 74-float (296-byte) stride based at this+0xD4, 3x3 orientation matrix at 0x34B0..0x34D0, world position at 0x34D4..0x34DC, integration fields at 0x3498..0x34AC, and the 0x3D48..0x3EB8 collision feedback threshold block.

compatibility_contracts.name: TireBrushModelLockProtocol
compatibility_contracts.description: Callers of the tire-brush solver must bracket work with TireBrushModelForceSolver(1) to acquire and TireBrushModelForceSolver(0) to release; the physics step and the collision wrapper both follow this protocol.

compatibility_contracts.name: IntegrationSubstepClamp
compatibility_contracts.description: The integration sub-step count stored at this+0x3498 must be clamped to [1,64]; step-size fields derive as 1.0/(40*v6) and 1.0/(8*(5*v6+5)) and this+0x34AC mirrors the global race-time double.

compatibility_contracts.name: PhysicsGlobalStateBlocks
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-frame setup reads global physics state: dword_7C8A18 (physics base; +28 orientation, +100 world position), dword_7C7918 (per-corner camera copy source), dbl_7C7428 (shared tire-model buffer), dword_5EA2C0 (physics node set), and the rotating noise table dword_8AAE70/flt_8AAE74 for randomized delays and damage draws.

compatibility_contracts.name: SuspensionForceFormula
compatibility_contracts.description: The temperature-scaled suspension force is computed as (temperature_term + 273.16) * input_factor * 0.002778858444950814 * scale + addend; a replacement must reproduce this arithmetic.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionFeedbackRingBuffer
compatibility_contracts.description: Collision spark/damage events are encoded into a 432-byte-strided ring buffer: dword_83EE60 counts live slots (cap 1023), dword_8AAE64 is the advancing slot base, ProgressBarEventEncode writes the slot header and direction bytes at slot+8..+14.

unresolved: Owner identity of the 'this' base across all 15 functions is inferred to be a single VehiclePhysicsObject from overlapping field evidence (orientation/world block 0x34B0..0x34DC shared by 0x4E49B0/0x4E5470/0x4E9BD0/0x4EC1A0/0x4EF6C0; wheel-state 74-float stride base 0xD4 shared by 0x4E24A0 and the 0x4E09E0 InitWithDualCall loop; init/reset overlap at 0x48..0x8C). The packet does not prove common ownership; audio config (0x5E4..0x6AD + 0xBA8), body collision zones (0xCC8..0xD90) and the camera snapshot block (0x3510..0x39F0) may be separate sub-objects.

The 82 DWORD literals written by the initializer (0x0..0x144) are not individually interpreted; the float meanings (contact/geometry, suspension/strut constants, scalar/vector defaults) are DERIVED prose, not packet evidence. Only the sentinel slots and transform-related early fields are modeled as named fields.

Per-wheel relative offsets inside the 74-float stride block (slots +53/+83/+100/+103/+104/+115/+116/+128/+140/+208) and the per-wheel bases in 0x4E5470 (float indices 3424/3429/3458/3480) are not packet fields; they are inferred from the raw source and preserved only as prose.

The 'obj'-base fields (0x32C8, 0x4894, 0x4898) belong to a caller-side base-object view (base-object counter, collision status, vehicle database slot). Identity of that base with the 'this' base is not established; they are not merged into VehiclePhysicsObject.

Read-only constant globals in the 0x59E4xx/0x5AD1xx ranges have no visible use in the decompiled bodies; they are likely tuning constants consumed by the called force/math routines, or .rdata slots backing double literals (e.g. 273.16, 0.002778858444950814). They are preserved in unresolved_evidence_refs.
Several per-frame setup fields (camera transform 0x3534..0x3548, dot rows 0x34F8..0x3500, 0x3D48..0x3D64) have no semantic names in the packet and are left as offsets with GUESS names.

unresolved_evidence_refs below preserves every required material ref not otherwise modeled in the architecture (remaining per-offset fields of the 0x0..0x144 initializer block and other field zones, globals without a data dependency, and the two annotative refs the packet listed verbatim).
unresolved_evidence_refs: field:obj:0x00004898 is listed in the packet field table but no obj-based access appears in the raw source; the base may belong to a caller-side object view.
global:0x0059E43C is listed in the packet global table but does not appear in the raw source text.
